title: Mison: A Fast JSON Parser for Data Analytics
relevance: Pioneered pushing projection operators into the JSON parser. Speculative field location prediction enables jumping directly to queried fields without full parsing. The fused parse-query concept extends this to arbitrary path queries with predicate evaluation.

title: JSONSki: streaming semi-structured data with bit-parallel fast-forwarding
relevance: Bit-parallel fast-forwarding skips irrelevant JSON regions during streaming. The fused approach achieves similar byte reduction but at the indexing level rather than the streaming level.

title: From Loop Fusion to Kernel Fusion: A Domain-Specific Approach to Locality Optimization
relevance: Formal framework for kernel fusion as graph partitioning. Applicable to determining which JSON parse and query operations should be fused for maximum locality benefit.

title: On-Demand JSON: A Better Way to Parse Documents?
relevance: On-Demand parsing defers materialization but still indexes all bytes. The fused approach avoids indexing irrelevant bytes entirely.
